cc:Work.dc:description: Bradley-Terry sigmoid background for the interactive lecture plot. Reward difference ranges from -4 to 4. Reference points: (0, 0.5) and (1, 0.7310585786). The HTML slide overlays a live probability marker controlled by two reward sliders.
